categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Leadmicro Nano Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in high-end micro-nano equipment manufacturing focused on advanced thin film deposition equipment. Its primary business segments include semiconductor equipment, photovoltaic (solar) equipment, and emerging applications such as flexible electronics and optical devices. The company provides equipment, spare parts, and related services mainly for semiconductor wafer and photovoltaic cell production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) vacuum thin film technologies, including Thermal ALD, Plasma Enhanced ALD (PEALD), Plasma Enhanced CVD (PECVD), Low Pressure CVD (LPCVD), and Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD). It develops advanced semiconductor thin film processing, vacuum coating reactor design, high-throughput vacuum coating, precise gas control, nano-layer film deposition, and high-quality film manufacturing technologies. The production methods emphasize modular, balanced, and digitalized manufacturing with strict quality and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves key customers in the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries, including leading domestic semiconductor manufacturers and top photovoltaic cell producers such as Tongwei, LONGi, JA Solar, Jinko, Canadian Solar, and Trina Solar. Its products are applied in logic chips, memory chips, compound semiconductors, new displays (silicon-based OLED), and advanced photovoltaic cells including PERC, TOPCon, XBC, HJT, and perovskite technologies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It serves domestic customers extensively and has growing overseas sales, although the majority of revenue is generated from the domestic market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Leadmicro Nano Technology operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and photovoltaic supply chains, manufacturing critical thin film deposition equipment used in wafer and solar cell production lines. It supplies advanced manufacturing equipment to downstream semiconductor fabs and photovoltaic cell producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in ALD and CVD technologies to support advanced semiconductor nodes and next-generation photovoltaic cells. It focuses on expanding product lines to cover logic, memory, compound semiconductors, new displays, and advanced packaging. The company also invests in emerging fields like flexible electronics and optical coatings. It maintains multiple national and provincial R&D platforms, collaborates with top universities and research institutes, and actively pursues intellectual property protection and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized equipment for semiconductor and photovoltaic manufacturing. Additional revenue streams include equipment upgrades, spare parts sales, and after-sales services such as maintenance and technical support. The company uses a direct sales model, engaging customers through direct negotiation and bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in ALD and CVD thin film deposition equipment, recognized as the first in China to commercialize High-k ALD equipment for front-end semiconductor manufacturing and hard mask CVD equipment. It competes against international giants like Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, and ASM International but holds a strong position in the domestic market with leading market share in ALD products. It is also a key equipment supplier for top Chinese photovoltaic manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.7 billion, a 60.74% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in both photovoltaic (52.94%) and semiconductor (168.44%) equipment sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 226.7 million, down 16.16% due to increased R&D expenses and provisions for credit risks. Total assets reached RMB 8.26 billion, up 8.96%, and net assets were RMB 2.6 billion, up 10.7%. The company maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~15.5% of revenue) and has a growing order backlog, especially in semiconductors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced ALD and CVD thin film deposition technologies that enable atomic-level precision, high uniformity, and excellent step coverage critical for next-generation semiconductor devices and high-efficiency photovoltaic cells. Its products support cutting-edge semiconductor nodes and emerging photovoltaic technologies like TOPCon, XBC, and perovskite cells. The company’s modular, customizable equipment design, strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading customers provide differentiated value through superior technology, reliability, and tailored solutions.
